ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ ۝١
ayahs.translation: By the star when it descends,
ayahs.translationClear: By the star as it goes down.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ ۝٢
ayahs.translation: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
ayahs.translationClear: Your friend has not gone astray, nor has he erred.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ ۝٣
ayahs.translation: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
ayahs.translationClear: Nor does he speak out of desire.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ ۝٤
ayahs.translation: It is not but a revelation revealed,
ayahs.translationClear: It is but a revelation revealed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ ۝٥
ayahs.translation: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -
ayahs.translationClear: Taught to him by the Extremely Powerful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ ۝٦
ayahs.translation: One of soundness.[1562] And he rose to [his] true form[1563]

footnotes.1562: i.e., strength of body and of mind.
footnotes.1563: Gabriel appeared to Muḥammad (ﷺ) at the outset of his prophethood in the angelic form in which Allāh originally created him.

ayahs.translationClear: The one of vigor. He settled.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ۝٧
ayahs.translation: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.[1564]

footnotes.1564: i.e., in the sky, above the eastern horizon.

ayahs.translationClear: While he was at the highest horizon.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ ۝٨
ayahs.translation: Then he approached and descended
ayahs.translationClear: Then he came near, and hovered around.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ ۝٩
ayahs.translation: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
ayahs.translationClear: He was within two bows’ length, or closer.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ ۝١٠
ayahs.translation: And he revealed to His Servant[1565] what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].

footnotes.1565: i.e., to the Servant of Allāh, Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

ayahs.translationClear: Then He revealed to His servant what He revealed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ ۝١١
ayahs.translation: The heart[1566] did not lie [about] what it saw.

footnotes.1566: i.e., mind or perception (of the Prophet [ﷺ]).

ayahs.translationClear: The heart did not lie about what it saw.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ ۝١٢

words.translation: Then will you dispute with him

ayahs.translation: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
ayahs.translationClear: Will you dispute with him concerning what he saw?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ ۝١٣
ayahs.translation: And he certainly saw him in another descent[1567]

footnotes.1567: i.e., on another occasion. During his ascent into the heavens (al-Miʿrāj), the Prophet (ﷺ) also saw Gabriel in his true form.

ayahs.translationClear: He saw him on another descent.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ ۝١٤
ayahs.translation: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
ayahs.translationClear: At the Lotus Tree of the Extremity.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ ۝١٥
ayahs.translation: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -
ayahs.translationClear: Near which is the Garden of Repose.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ ۝١٦
ayahs.translation: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].[1568]

footnotes.1568: Then and there he (ﷺ) saw Gabriel in angelic form.

ayahs.translationClear: As there covered the Lotus Tree what covered it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ ۝١٧
ayahs.translation: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
ayahs.translationClear: The sight did not waver, nor did it exceed.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: لَقَدْ رَاٰي مِنْ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرٰي
ayahs.translation: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad ra-aa min aayaati Rabbihil kubraaa
ayahs.translationClear: He saw some of the Great Signs of his Lord.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ ۝١٩
ayahs.translation: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?
ayahs.translationClear: Have you considered al-Lat and al-Uzza?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ ۝٢٠
ayahs.translation: And Manāt, the third - the other one?[1569]

footnotes.1569: The three names given in this and the previous verse are those of well-known "goddesses" which were worshipped by the pagan Arabs before the spread of Islām.

ayahs.translationClear: And Manat, the third one, the other?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۝٢١
ayahs.translation: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
ayahs.translationClear: Are you to have the males, and He the females?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ ۝٢٢
ayahs.translation: That, then, is an unjust division.[1570]
ayahs.translationClear: What a bizarre distribution.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ‌ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ‌ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنْ هِيَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَسْمَا࢜ءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوْهَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ وَاٰبَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ مَّا͏ٓ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطٰنٍؕ اِنْ يَّتَّبِعُوْنَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَي الْاَنْفُسُۚ وَلَقَدْ جَا࢜ءَهُمْ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمُ الْهُدٰي ؕ
ayahs.translation: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
ayahs.transliteration: In hiya illaaa asmaaa'un sammaitumoohaaa antum Wa-aabaaa'ukum maaa anzalal laahu bihaa min sultaan; ien yattabi'oona illaz zanna Wa-maa tahwal anfusu Wa-laqad jaaa'ahum mir Rabbihimul hudaa
ayahs.translationClear: These are nothing but names, which you have devised, you and your ancestors, for which Allah sent down no authority. They follow nothing but assumptions, and what the ego desires, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ ۝٢٤
ayahs.translation: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
ayahs.translationClear: Or is the human being to have whatever he desires?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝٢٥
ayahs.translation: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
ayahs.translationClear: To Allah belong the Last and the First.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَمْ مِّنْ مَّلَكٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ لَا تُغْنِيْ شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْـٔ͏ًا اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اَنْ يَّاْذَنَ اللّٰهُ لِمَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ وَيَرْضٰي
ayahs.translation: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-kam mim malakin fis samaawaati laa tughnee shafaa'atuhum shai'an illaa mim ba'di aien yaathanal laahu limaien yashaaa'u Wa-yardaa
ayahs.translationClear: How many an angel is there in the heavens whose intercession avails nothing, except after Allah gives permission to whomever He wills, and approves?

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّوْنَ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ الْاُنْثٰي
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
ayahs.transliteration: innal latheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati la-yusammoonal malaaa'ikata tasmiyatal unsaa
ayahs.translationClear: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels the names of females.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ‌ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ‌ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا لَهُمْ بِهٖ مِنْ عِلْمٍؕ اِنْ يَّتَّبِعُوْنَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّۚ وَاِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِيْ مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْـٔ͏ًا ۚ
ayahs.translation: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa lahum bihee min 'ilmin ien yattabi'oona illaz zanna Wa-innaz zanna laa yughnee minal haqqi shai'aa
ayahs.translationClear: They have no knowledge of that. They only follow assumptions, and assumptions are no substitute for the truth.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَعْرِضْ عَنْ مَّنْ تَوَلّٰي࣢ۙ عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ اِلَّا الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا ؕ
ayahs.translation: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-a'rid 'am man tawallaa 'an thikrinaa Wa-lam yurid illal hayaatad dunyaa
ayahs.translationClear: So avoid him who has turned away from Our remembrance, and desires nothing but the present life.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ‌ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُمْ مِّنَ الْعِلْمِؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيْلِهٖۙ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اهْتَدٰي
ayahs.translation: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
ayahs.transliteration: Thalika mablaghuhum minal 'ilm; inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabee-lihee Wa-huwa a'lamu bimanih tadaa
ayahs.translationClear: That is the extent of their knowledge. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best who has accepted guidance.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلِلّٰهِ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِۙ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسَا࢜ءُوْا بِمَا عَمِلُوْا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَحْسَنُوْا بِالْحُسْنٰي ۚ
ayahs.translation: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-lillaahi maa fis samaawaati Wa-maa fil ardi liyajziyal latheena asaaa'oo bimaa 'amiloo Wa-yajziyal latheena ahsanoo bilhusnaa
ayahs.translationClear: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and recompense those who do good with the best.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ‌ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ‌ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ‌ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ‌ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَّذِيْنَ يَجْتَنِبُوْنَ كَبٰ࢜ىِٕرَ الْاِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ اِلَّا اللَّمَمَؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِؕ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ اِذْ اَنْشَاَكُمْ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ وَاِذْ اَنْتُمْ اَجِنَّةٌ فِيْ بُطُوْنِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمْۚ فَلَا تُزَكُّوْٓا اَنْفُسَكُمْؕ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقٰي ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
ayahs.transliteration: Allatheena yajtaniboona kabaaa'iral ismi walfawaa-hisha illal lamam; inna rabbaka waasi'ul maghfirah; huwa a'lamu bikum ith ansha-akum minal ardi Wa-ith antum ajinnatun fee butooni umma-haatikum falaa tuzakkooo anfusakum huwa a'lamu bimanit taqaa
ayahs.translationClear: Those who avoid gross sins and indecencies—except for minor lapses—your Lord is of Vast Forgiveness. He knows you well, ever since He created you from the earth, and ever since you were embryos in your mothers’ wombs. So do not acclaim your own virtue; He is fully aware of the righteous.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ ۝٣٣
ayahs.translation: Have you seen the one who turned away
ayahs.translationClear: Have you considered him who turned away?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ ۝٣٤
ayahs.translation: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
ayahs.translationClear: And gave a little, and held back?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ ۝٣٥
ayahs.translation: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?[1571]

footnotes.1571: Knows that his provision will be exhausted if he spends on the poor, while Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) has promised otherwise.

ayahs.translationClear: Does he possess knowledge of the unseen, and can therefore foresee?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّاْ بِمَا فِيْ صُحُفِ مُوْسٰي ۙ
ayahs.translation: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
ayahs.transliteration: Am lam yunabbaa bimaa fee suhuhfi Moosa
ayahs.translationClear: Or was he not informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ ۝٣٧
ayahs.translation: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
ayahs.translationClear: And of Abraham, who fulfilled?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۝٣٨
ayahs.translation: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
ayahs.translationClear: That no soul bears the burdens of another soul.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَنْ لَّيْسَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ اِلَّا مَا سَعٰي ۙ
ayahs.translation: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-al laisa lil-insaani illaa maa sa'aa
ayahs.translationClear: And that the human being attains only what he strives for.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ ۝٤٠
ayahs.translation: And that his effort is going to be seen -
ayahs.translationClear: And that his efforts will be witnessed.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ ۝٤١

words.translation: he will be recompensed for it

ayahs.translation: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -
ayahs.translationClear: Then he will be rewarded for it the fullest reward.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ ۝٤٢
ayahs.translation: And that to your Lord is the finality
ayahs.translationClear: And that to your Lord is the finality.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ ۝٤٣
ayahs.translation: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
ayahs.translationClear: And that it is He who causes laughter and weeping.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا ۝٤٤
ayahs.translation: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
ayahs.translationClear: And that it is He who gives death and life.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۝٤٥
ayahs.translation: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
ayahs.translationClear: And that it is He who created the two kinds—the male and the female.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ ۝٤٦
ayahs.translation: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
ayahs.translationClear: From a sperm drop, when emitted.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ ۝٤٧
ayahs.translation: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.
ayahs.translationClear: And that upon Him is the next existence.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ ۝٤٨
ayahs.translation: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
ayahs.translationClear: And that it is He who enriches and impoverishes.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ ۝٤٩
ayahs.translation: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius[1572]

footnotes.1572: A star worshipped by some of the pagan Arabs.

ayahs.translationClear: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝٥٠
ayahs.translation: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad
ayahs.translationClear: And that it is He who destroyed the first Aad.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ ۝٥١
ayahs.translation: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -
ayahs.translationClear: And Thamood, sparing no one.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ‌ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَوْمَ نُوْحٍ مِّنْ قَبْلُؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا هُمْ اَظْلَمَ وَاَطْغٰي ؕ
ayahs.translation: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaanoo hum azlama Wa-atghaa
ayahs.translationClear: And the people of Noah before that; for they were most unjust and most oppressive.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ ۝٥٣
ayahs.translation: And the overturned towns[1573] He hurled down
ayahs.translationClear: And He toppled the ruined cities.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ ۝٥٤
ayahs.translation: And covered them by that which He covered.[1574]
ayahs.translationClear: And covered them with whatever covered them.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ ۝٥٥
ayahs.translation: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
ayahs.translationClear: So which of your Lord’s marvels can you deny?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ ۝٥٦
ayahs.translation: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.
ayahs.translationClear: This is a warning, just like the first warnings.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ ۝٥٧
ayahs.translation: The Approaching Day has approached.
ayahs.translationClear: The inevitable is imminent.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ كَاشِفَةٌ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.
ayahs.transliteration: Laisa lahaa min doonil laahi kaashifah
ayahs.translationClear: None besides Allah can unveil it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ ۝٥٩
ayahs.translation: Then at this statement do you wonder?
ayahs.translationClear: Do you marvel at this discourse?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ ۝٦٠
ayahs.translation: And you laugh and do not weep
ayahs.translationClear: And laugh, and do not weep?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ ۝٦١
ayahs.translation: While you are proudly sporting?[1575]

footnotes.1575: Additional meanings are "singing [with expanded chest]," "heedless," or "lost in vain amusements."

ayahs.translationClear: Lost in your frivolity?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩ ۝٦٢
ayahs.translation: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].
ayahs.translationClear: So bow down to Allah, and worship!
